parameters.name: Arp
parameters.description: Specifies whether address resolution protocol (ARP) is enabled for the check type.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: Ping
parameters.description: Specifies whether ping is enabled for the check type.

parameters.name: ProbeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the probe.

> You can call the [ListHoneypotProbe](~~ListHoneypotProbe~~) operation to query the IDs of probes.

parameters.name: ServiceIpList
parameters.description: The IP addresses that are monitored.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-honeypot-probe --probe-id bbe7e382-956f-473e-beed-bc73a2580000 --display-name svwsx-vpc-4430 --ping true --arp false --service-ip-list 192.168.XX.XX --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdateHoneypotProbe --region cn-hangzhou --Ping true --DisplayName 'svwsx-vpc-4430' --Lang zh --ServiceIpList.1 '192.168.XX.XX' --ProbeId 'bbe7e382-956f-473e-beed-bc73a2580000' --Arp false
